company.name: ElevenLabs
company.shortDescription: ElevenLabs develops artificial intelligence software focused on speech synthesis and voice generation.
company.description:
ElevenLabs develops artificial intelligence software focused on speech synthesis and voice generation. It provides text-to-speech models that convert written content into audio using machine learning systems. The company offers voice cloning capabilities that allow creation of custom voices from audio samples. Its platform includes tools for speech generation, dubbing, and audio localization across multiple languages. Developers access application programming interfaces and software tools to integrate voice features into digital products. The technology is used in applications such as narration, conversational agents, and accessibility solutions for converting text into spoken output. 

Its offerings include tools for creating voiceovers, music, and sound effects, as well as conversational agents that communicate across voice and text channels. The platform supports multilingual applications and enables users to build, deploy, and monitor interactive agents with defined workflows and controls. Its technology is used by developers, enterprises, and content creators to integrate audio-based AI into applications and media production.
